description: "In the governor's race, the two major parties vet their candidates and whittle each field to one nominee in a primary. Everyone else is dumped onto one independent ballot requiring only 25 signatures and an eligibility claim that no one checks, then sent straight to the November general election. In 2026, this meant 13 of 15 names on the ballot were independents. Year after year, that crowd becomes the excuse to keep independents out of debates and to dismiss even strong ones as spoilers. My plan sets one bar for everyone (2,500 signatures), gives independents a primary of their own, and brings ranked ballots to the governor’s race in 2034 so no one is a spoiler."
paid_for_by: Paid for by David Seeman for Governor
title: Governorship Maturation Act
